[SWS_DM_01220] Adding wildcards to a DynamicAccessList
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04240, RS_Diag_04234
⌈
If the method
ara::diag::DynamicAccessListDiagServiceBuilder::Any
of the class
ara::diag::DynamicAccessListDiagServiceBuilder
is called by
the application, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall add the passed number
of bytes to the DynamicAccessList, but shall not consider them during pattern match-
ing.
⌋
For Example, 22F1XX could be used in the pattern to add all ReadDataByIdentifier
Requests for DIDs beginning with 0xF1 to the DynamicAccessList.
